primary_gt.computed_implication: The 0.25 rainfall fraction, roughly 41000 hotspots, and three smoke-transport anchors identify a dry Nepal fire-smoke episode with broad satellite-observed smoke movement.

criteria.name: JSON response contract
criteria.description: Returns parseable JSON with top-level answer, metrics, and computed_implication, and includes all three requested metric keys.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a clearly structured response with one missing or renamed field.

criteria.name: Compact label
criteria.description: Gives dry_hotspot_smoke_transport_signature or an accepted equivalent centered on dry conditions, hotspot burden, and smoke transport.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a wildfire-smoke label that is directionally correct but too generic.

criteria.name: Reported rainfall fraction
criteria.description: Extracts that Nepal received just a quarter of normal January-April rainfall and reports 0.25 within 0.001.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for recognizing a severe rainfall deficit but missing the normalized fraction.

criteria.name: Reported hotspot count
criteria.description: Reports approximately 41,000 VIIRS hotspots within 500 detections and treats the value as an approximate detection count.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the right order of magnitude or a nearby rounded value outside tolerance.

criteria.name: Smoke transport anchors
criteria.description: Counts the three report anchors: smoke enveloping much of Nepal, a smoke pall near Pokhara, and eastward smoke transport toward India and Bangladesh.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correct anchor.

criteria.name: Computation-to-label link
criteria.description: Connects the three values to the final label without adding claims beyond the report-supported numeric signature.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for connecting only two of the three values to the label.

criteria.name: Concise bounded implication
criteria.description: Gives a one-sentence implication limited to dry conditions, hotspot detections, and smoke transport.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if the implication is mostly bounded but includes one minor overstatement.

notes: Off-event Open-Meteo daily weather and Sentinel-2 dNBR are not used in this ground truth.
The scored values come from the declared event anchor and NASA Earth Observatory report text.
